problem_register_binding.source: Trading Room and Strategy Performance were not aligned to V11 / V6 §15: missing grid-editor strings, queue not live and not in the views, duplicate queue code, 先調整版面/交代僕人 mis-targeted, English labels, no rule-vs-human comparison, shadow comparison on the Management route.

dependency.contract: Four arms human_actual/private_servant/base_strategy/committee_variant, status ok|degraded|empty, data.comparison_state settled|pending_settlement|unavailable|no_decision_recorded; unknown or foreign decision answers an identical 404.

AC1_grid_editor_keys_and_guard.keys: agora.tradingRoom.editor.{enterEditMode,exitEditMode,versionHistory,restoreWidget} added to zh-TW and en-US, plus the editor/live/mobile/decisionCard/intent/candidateReview/candidateContext catalogs and agora.performance.{ruleVsHuman,shadow}.
AC1_grid_editor_keys_and_guard.guard: src/agora/i18n.guard.test.ts scans every non-test .tsx under pages/trading-room, trading-room, pages/strategy-performance, widgets, TradeDecisionCard and CandidateReviewDrawer for static t("agora.…") keys and fails on any key missing from zh-TW or en-US (plural suffixes honoured); also asserts catalog parity for the new namespaces and detects a missing key in a sample. Before this change the scan found the four editor keys, agora.tradingRoom.proposal.validationIssues (plural, resolves) and the whole unused agora.tradingRoom.attribution namespace.

AC2_live_queue_in_view.stream: subscribeTradingRoomStream (src/lib/bff-v1/agora/tradingRoom.ts) subscribes to GET /bff/agora/trading-room/stream with the fetch-based SSE client (Authorization + session cookie + Last-Event-ID replay). 401/403 or 3 consecutive failures fall back to bounded polling (fixed interval, minimum 5 s, default 15 s). TradingRoomPage debounces events/polls into a silent re-read of the resync routes (decision-events and the aggregate) so the queue updates without reload.
AC2_live_queue_in_view.widget: src/agora/widgets/DecisionQueueWidget.tsx renders signal_decision_queue / overview_decision_queue (V11 View A) as entry/add/reduce/exit lanes shown together with counts, live-mode badge and last update time; read-only.
AC2_live_queue_in_view.duplicate_code_removed: TradingRoomPage no longer contains its own TradingEventQueue, DecisionEventDetailPanel, PositionActionQueue, RiskBanner, EVENT_KIND_LABEL/STATE_LABEL and error helpers (dead copies of TradingRoomWorkspace code); it imports RiskBanner from TradingRoomWorkspace.
AC2_live_queue_in_view.layout_fix: Real-browser run showed the workspace grid squeezed to ~30 px by the stacked panes; the workspace pane now has a 560 px minimum and the column scrolls.

AC3_adjust_layout_and_servant.adjust_layout: 先調整版面 accepts the reviewed preview and mounts the grid editor with initialEditMode=true (WorkspaceGridEditor.initialEditMode).
AC3_adjust_layout_and_servant.ask_servant: Header 交代僕人 targets the selected widget (selection taken on press because the grid swallows the click in edit mode, also on focus/click); with no selection it asks the trader to pick one, with no widgets it says to add one. Never silently targets widgets[0].
AC3_adjust_layout_and_servant.labels: Rollback, version history, current, personalization, mobile pane/risk/strategies, candidate context and workspace chrome are zh-TW via i18n keys.

AC4_decision_card_drawer_intent.zh_tw: TradeDecisionCard section titles, EV fields, consult/modify panels and CandidateReviewDrawer (title, columns, bands, decisions, decomposition, footer) are zh-TW.
AC4_decision_card_drawer_intent.intent_progress: IntentStatus shows a read-only progress ladder (created → submitted → accepted → paper running → paper fills reported) and owner-reported paper fills (tradingIntentProgress parses paper_fills/fills on the intent or its handoffs; fills claiming a live broker venue are ignored; an unreported field reads 紙上執行服務尚未回報成交). No order action is offered; the only buttons remain the pre-existing governed Shadow/paper-test handoff requests, withdraw and refresh.

AC5_performance.rule_vs_human: src/agora/pages/strategy-performance/RuleVsHumanComparison.tsx: per intervention, side by side: rule would do (base_strategy arm / decision-event suggestion), trader did (human_actual arm, else the intervention kind), reason, result, and shadow outcome had the trader not intervened (base_strategy settlement).
AC5_performance.link_honesty: InterventionRecord has no structural decision link (its source_id is the projector id and the schema forbids extra fields). An intervention is linked only through ids the owners report: its evidence refs / source id, or the decision_ids of a journey row sharing one of its evidence refs, matched against the trader's decision events. Otherwise it renders 未連結裁示事件 with every value 未回報; no link is ever guessed. This is a backend follow-up: carry decision_event_id on InterventionRecord.
AC5_performance.shadow_section: Strategy Performance has a shadow comparison section (ShadowComparisonPanel) and getTradingRoomShadowComparison now reads the Agora owner route above; no Management route remains in src/agora.
AC5_performance.attribution: AttributionReportView was DELETED (with its test and the Management-route client getTradingRoomPerformanceAttribution): it was never rendered (only re-exported), called /bff/management/performance-attribution/by-strategy, and duplicated the strategy table StrategyPerformancePage already builds from the Agora owner route getAgoraPerformanceAttribution (/bff/agora/trading-room/performance-attribution/by-strategy). Its two client tests were retargeted to getAgoraPerformanceAttribution, not removed.
AC5_performance.missing_values: The formatters no longer default to the English 'not reported'; every missing value reads the zh-TW 未回報 (formatters now require the localized fallback).

AC6_checks.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit and tsc -p tsconfig.agora.json --noEmit → exit 0.
AC6_checks.vitest: src/agora + src/i18n + src/lib/bff-v1: 100 files / 1323 tests passed; remaining suites (all non-agora): 261 files / 3205 tests passed; locale parity suites 8 files / 178 tests passed.
AC6_checks.tests_not_weakened: No test deleted except AttributionReportView.test.tsx together with the deleted component. Existing English-copy assertions were changed to the zh-TW copy the acceptance requires (same or stronger assertions); mocks gained the new exports; the two getTradingRoomPerformanceAttribution tests were retargeted to the Agora owner client (the old test asserted no X-Request-Id; the shared Agora read client sends a tracing X-Request-Id on reads, so that single negative assertion was replaced by a comment and the no-If-Match/no-Idempotency-Key assertions remain).

AC7_hosted_proof.recorded_fixture_screenshots: docs/deployment/evidence/FE-AGORA-TRADING-ROOM-PERFORMANCE-ALIGN-20261127/screenshots/ (01 live decision queue in the view, 02 edit mode zh-TW, 03 交代僕人 on the selected widget, 04 proposal preview, 05 先調整版面 opens edit mode, 06 performance rule-vs-human + shadow) produced by e2e/agora-trading-room-performance-align.spec.ts in real Chromium against the built SPA with route fixtures.
AC7_hosted_proof.hosted: Pending: the admintest hosted run needs the merged commit on dev, the integration gate and the dev FE deploy, and an interactive admintest session; none exist from this worker. e2e/agora-winner-branch-hosted.spec.ts was updated for the zh-TW copy and now also records the decision-queue lanes and edit-mode screenshots; e2e/agora-product-journey.spec.ts gained a rule-vs-human/shadow step with a screenshot. Re-run both hosted after deploy as admintest with the walkthrough strategy.

pre_existing_failures_not_caused_by_this: e2e/agora-candidate-truth.spec.ts asserts testids (candidate-data-source, candidate-row-AAPL, 'Live dataset') removed from the Trading Room by e4146224a; it fails identically on origin/dev. Not edited.

e2e/29-persona-interaction.spec.ts 'Trading Room Ask Personas…' lands on the login page with its fixture and fails identically on origin/dev (verified from a clean git archive of origin/dev). Only its 'Decision recorded: modify' copy assertion was updated to the zh-TW text.
residual_findings: InterventionRecord needs a structural decision_event_id for guaranteed rule-vs-human linking (backend follow-up).

Paper fills are rendered when the owner reports paper_fills/fills on the TradingIntent or its handoffs; the current BFF intent route does not report them yet, so hosted shows 紙上執行服務尚未回報成交 until it does.
Intervention kind/status and settlement reason codes are rendered as the owner-authored values (e.g. manual_override, recorded).
